name: What is the typical cost to fix a sewer smell from drains?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to fix a sewer smell from drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a sewer smell varies widely depending on the underlying cause. A simple fix like refilling a dry P-trap costs nothing. If a plumber needs to clear a minor clog, it might be a standard service call fee. For more complex issues like repairing a cracked vent pipe, replacing a section of a sewer line, or addressing a main line blockage, costs can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars. An inspection is usually required to provide an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary from free for simple P-trap refills to several thousand dollars for major sewer line repairs. An inspection is needed for an accurate estimate.
